WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    o.recordvault,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as group_avg
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan
),
timespan_avg_of_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    AVG(group_avg) as timespan_avg
  FROM group_avgs
  GROUP BY timespan
),
with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.recordvault,
    ga.timespan,
    ga.group_avg,
    ga.group_avg - tag.timespan_avg as diff
  FROM group_avgs ga
  INNER JOIN timespan_avg_of_groups tag ON ga.timespan = tag.timespan
  WHERE ga.group_avg > tag.timespan_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    recordvault,
    timespan,
    group_avg,
    diff,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY group_avg DESC NULLS LAST) as rnk
  FROM with_diff
)
SELECT 
  recordvault,
  timespan,
  group_avg,
  diff,
  rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rnk
